adjudication.rationale: The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` uses `def change` but includes multiple raw `execute` calls that mutate data (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ...`, `DELETE FROM site_settings ...`). adjudication_records.issue_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:9-11 — unguarded `[0]['id']` on a query that returns 0 rows on the common case (no embed_category override), crashing the migration; sibling query 3 lines below correctly guards with cmd_tuples check (confidence=90, severity=P0)

Yes. In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration does:

category_id = execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i

If that SELECT returns 0 rows (e.g., no embed_category configured / no matching category name), the result set has no element at index 0, so `[0]` is nil and `[0]['id']` will raise (NoMethodError / undefined method `[]` for nil). VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. The value `h` comes from `site_settings.value` (legacy `embeddable_hosts`) and is not SQL-escaped or parameterized. adjudication_records.issue_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:25 vs app/models/embeddable_host.rb:5-8 — raw INSERT bypasses the model's URL-scheme/path normalization, so migrated full-URL host entries can never match `record_for_host` again post-upgrade (confidence=65, severity=P1)

adjudication.rationale: Yes. The migration inserts `h` directly into `embeddable_hosts.host` via raw SQL (`INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without running the `EmbeddableHost` model’s `before_validation` normalization that strips `http(s)://` and paths. adjudication_records.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:10-11,15-16 — `.where(id:).first` instead of `.find` plus no nil check turns a routine bad-id request into an uncaught 500 instead of 404 (confidence=90, severity=P2)

adjudication.rationale: Yes. In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update` and `#destroy`, the code does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then immediately calls methods on `host` (`save_host(host)` which does `host.host = ...`, and `host.destroy`). If the id is invalid/nonexistent, `where(...).first` returns `nil`, leading to a `NoMethodError` and a 500 response. Using `find` (or `find_by!`) would raise `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound`, which Rails typically turns into a 404, or alternatively the code should explicitly handle `nil`.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:5-8 — nil `host` param crashes the before_validation callback (`nil.sub!`) before validation can run (confidence=60, severity=P2)

adjudication.rationale: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb the `before_validation` block calls `self.host.sub!(...)` twice with no nil guard. `before_validation` runs before `validates_format_of :host`, and there is no `validates_presence_of :host`.
